def boxes(frame):
    a = frame.ascii.split('\n')
    res={}
    for col in ('b','S'):
        pts=[(r,c) for r in range(16,25) for c in range(10,46) if a[r][c]==col]
        if pts:
            rs=[p[0] for p in pts]; cs=[p[1] for p in pts]
            res[col]=(min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs),len(pts))
    return res
print("now", boxes(current_frame))
action(['RIGHT'])
print("after RIGHT", boxes(current_frame))
action(['RIGHT'])

</parameter>
</function>
